notes: REF-BM-02: metadata fetch collects only title+description; no favicon or preview image. REF-BM-04: edits url/title/description/tags but no note field exists in model. REF-BM-06: duplicate detected and creation blocked, but UI only offers Cancel or 'Save another copy'; does not route user into editing the existing bookmark. REF-BM-07: card shows title/description/tags but uses a first-letter avatar, not a favicon. REF-BM-12: search covers title/url/description(+tags) but no note field. REF-BM-10: tags entered as plain comma-separated text, no autocomplete/datalist. REF-BM-14: no #tag syntax parsing. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parentheses; single LIKE term. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact match. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread flag or unread view. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions. REF-BM-22: list order fixed to created_at DESC; no sort key selection. REF-BM-23: no markdown note field. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot or Internet Archive support. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archived flag or archive view. REF-BM-29: no bundles. REF-BM-30/31: no import/export. REF-BM-32: no user settings.
